summary: First end-to-end ranking/evaluation harness: tools/eval_probe.py freezes a 318-paper arXiv candidate set, ranks it with recency / keyword+date / TF-IDF-seed-centroid, blind-labels the union with the evaluation annotator (taomu) and computes P@k, plus 6 unit tests. Result is a documented negative: the annotator marked 96% useful and the pool is pre-filtered, so P@k cannot discriminate systems. No quality claim; E-RANKING stays not_run.
scope_note: Covers the diff since commit 3cca932. New experiment tooling + tests + registries/docs; freeze/rank/score require no network or model.

budget_impact.rationale: No app runtime and no runtime-provider call. The only spend was the evaluation annotator (taomu, ADR 0004): 6 calls, ~32,400 tokens total, of which ~4,224 were the cached hidden prefix per call; labels cached in .local so re-runs spend nothing. Runtime ceilings unchanged.
budget_impact.before: No measurement harness; no frozen candidate set; no ranking comparison.
budget_impact.after: Frozen 318-paper set (hash 0c06666429815cc8), 3 ranking systems, 26 blind proxy labels and P@k scoring; negative result recorded and E-RANKING left not_run.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: Cached labels; documents the non-discriminative P@k and the 96% positive warning

reviews.reviewer: Implementing agent; harness/tooling only, not recommendation quality

open_risks: Measurement has no discriminative power: pre-filtered pool + lenient annotator (96% positive).
No E-LLM-LABEL-VALIDITY spot-check yet; proxy labels unvalidated.
REUSE-01 upstream probe still outstanding; this is only the fixed-baseline harness.
taomu relay flaky and UA-restricted; hidden prefix makes per-call cost unverifiable.
